connections.reason: Aircraft positions from an ADS-B decoder (dump1090, readsb) that serves SBS-1 (BaseStation) text on TCP port 30003, as each link in the settings names it. The host and port come only from the links. Input only: nothing is sent.

internet.reason: A link may point at a decoder on another host, which an administrator names in the links. No host is built in and none comes from received data.

dataTypes.name: ADS-B aircraft
dataTypes.description: Aircraft received as SBS-1 lines from an ADS-B decoder, at their last reported position.

fields.name: squawk
fields.label: Squawk
fields.description: The transponder code, four octal digits (SBS-1 MSG,6).

fields.name: altitudeFt
fields.label: Altitude
fields.description: The barometric altitude as the aircraft reports it, in feet (not SI, on purpose: pilots and the feed use feet).

fields.name: verticalRateFpm
fields.label: Vertical rate
fields.description: The climb (positive) or descent (negative) rate, in feet per minute.

fields.name: emergency
fields.label: Emergency
fields.description: Whether the aircraft declares an emergency.

fields.name: onGround
fields.label: On ground
fields.description: Whether the aircraft reports that it is on the ground.

links.title: Links
links.description: The decoders to read, one entry per link. Without an entry the plugin does nothing. A link's name is the data source of what it receives.

x-emc2.hint: One entry per decoder. A link's name is its data source.

groups.label: Connection
groups.description: The decoder the link reads from, and when a silent link connects again.

groups.label: Picture
groups.description: Where the link's aircraft go, and how they are drawn.

groups.label: Security label
groups.description: The security label of the link's layer and aircraft.

name.title: Name
name.description: The link's name: lowercase words separated by hyphens, at most 64 characters (e.g. dump1090-north). It is the data source of what the link receives.

x-emc2.hint: Lowercase words and hyphens, e.g. dump1090-north.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: tcp-client: connects to the decoder's SBS-1 output and reads it. The only mode.

direction.title: Direction
direction.description: in: the link receives. The only direction.

port.title: Port
port.description: The decoder's SBS-1 port (dump1090 serves it on 30003).

idleSeconds.title: Reconnect when idle
idleSeconds.description: A link that gets nothing for this long is closed and connected again. 0: never.

x-emc2.hint: Reconnect after this long without data. 0: never.

targetLayer.title: Layer
targetLayer.description: Where the aircraft go: a layer picked in the form (the "+" beside the picker creates one at once, and it keeps its id). Absent: a layer named like the link. A picked layer that is gone is made again by its name at the next aircraft. Two links that name the same layer share one.

x-emc2.hint: Pick a layer, or use + to make one. Absent: named like the link.

label.title: Security label
label.description: The security label of the link's layer and of the aircraft it creates. Default: the server's default label.

x-emc2.hint: The layer's and the aircraft's security label.

classification.title: Classification
classification.description: The classification the policy defines, e.g. UNCLASSIFIED.

standardIdentity.title: Standard identity
standardIdentity.description: The APP-6D standard identity of every aircraft of the link. ADS-B does not say whether an aircraft is friend or foe: set neutral for civil traffic.

x-emc2.hint: Set neutral for civil traffic; ADS-B does not say.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether the plugin runs this link.
